_comment: One config per job. Paths are relative to this file. Casting-local frame AFTER orientation: draw = Z, parting Z = 0, feeding face = +Y, long axis = X. Values below are from the first (rocker-lever) job - replace per part.

orientation._comment: applied in order, degrees; add ["z", 180] to make the underside the feeding face

feeding._comment: one neck per isolated hot spot: x = hot-spot X, face_y = Y of the feeding face there, w x t = neck section (t straddles parting)

shell._comment_core: core_box = casting-local [x0,x1,y0,y1,0,z_top] print seat for the cope; z_top above the highest pocket ceiling; null if no core
